verdict.rationale: Apple's own marketing claims efficiency and battery life gains from the M4 Max's architecture, but there are no documented power envelope figures (TDP/sustained wattage) and no independent thermal-throttling or performance-per-watt testing in the evidence; community comments even note the lack of such battery/sustained-load benchmarks. missing for 10: documented power envelope specs, independent sustained-render throttling tests, performance-per-watt benchmarks under long export workloads.
